articles.title: Market Ripple: Rising Yields and Oil Prices Push US Stocks Down
articles.description: US stocks declined on Thursday due to concerns over potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. Rising oil prices and climbing Treasury yields contributed to market unease. Key players such as Nvidia and Micron suffered losses, while investors anticipate Friday's consumer price data for further guidance.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Tim Cook, 'You want to be the pebble in the pond that creates the ripple for change' offers powerful lessons about creating change, why small actions, bold ideas and innovation can
articles.description: Quote of the day by Tim Cook teaches us to stop underestimating individual influence. Nobody needs to control an entire organization, invent a revolutionary technology or possess extraordinary wealth to begin creating change. A single idea can start a conversation, a single decision can inspire another person and a single act of courage can become the beginning of something much larger.

articles.title: US oil jumps above $100 and stock futures slump
articles.description: Amid the escalating U.S.-Iran conflict, crude oil prices in the U.S. have surged past one hundred dollars, leading to marked increases in global oil benchmarks that ripple through international markets. This surge coincides with a decline in U.S. stock futures, attributed to rising wholesale inflation in August. Meanwhile, the European Central Bank has raised its key interest rate to address mounting inflation, directly affecting household budgets and shipping costs.
